info.title: Hardy Home Household API
info.description: Family and display device API. Protected requests use enrolled P256 device signatures. Connection management is owner-only on the isolated HTTPS ingress and bypasses chat, drafts, transcripts and model tools. Secret-bearing request fields are write-only and never returned. Current identity, audience and domain grants are rechecked server-side. Conversation folders and placements are private to the signed profile and never change chat access. Conversation deletion removes the app entry while retaining native history and audit; active or uncertain work must first be stopped.

DeviceId.name: X-Hardy-Device-Id
DeviceId.description: Enrolled device id. Personal and display device kinds have separate server-enforced routes; profile ids are not caller-selected.

DeviceTimestamp.name: X-Hardy-Timestamp
DeviceTimestamp.description: 13-digit Unix epoch milliseconds, accepted within five minutes of server time.

DeviceNonce.name: X-Hardy-Nonce
DeviceNonce.description: Fresh single-use nonce, 16–128 characters, consumed durably for this enrolled device.

DeviceSignature.name: X-Hardy-Signature
DeviceSignature.description: Base64 DER ECDSA P-256/SHA-256 signature over UTF-8 lines joined by LF: uppercase METHOD, exact request path including encoded query, timestamp, nonce, lowercase SHA-256 hex of exact body bytes. Empty bodies use SHA-256 of zero bytes. The same path/body bytes must be sent after signing.

folderId.description: Current signed profile's private sidebar placement; other viewers have independent placement.

publicKeyDerBase64.description: Base64 DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo for an ECDSA P-256 public key. The private key remains on the enrolling device.

SubmitMessage.description: A normal human prompt with immutable signed task metadata. Task/brain_dump/diagnostic text is limited to 16000 characters. A reply cannot also start a new goal; approval questionId must equal replyToQuestionId. Diagnosis requires an admin private conversation and stays read-only across continuations.

SubmissionReceipt.description: Durable admission receipt. waiting_for_user releases settled execution capacity while retaining the native goal and durable question; it does not imply completion.

ConversationContext.description: Owner-only native state projection. Native OpenClaw remains the execution authority.

ArtifactInput.description: Stages an immutable input in the current owner/conversation anchor. audience defaults to private. To admit an input into a shared task, its audience must match the shared conversation; task/owner/output-kind are never accepted from the client.

Artifact.description: Immutable scoped metadata. Inputs use a conversation anchor until admitted into a native task; clients cannot choose owner, task, kind or filesystem paths.

DeviceKind.description: Server-assigned enrolled-device boundary. A display device can read only display routes; it is not a family chat device.

ResourceFocus.description: A currently authorized read-view resource to discuss in a normal prompt. The server validates scope and revision; this is not a tool invocation or grant.

ApprovalDecision.description: A fresh signed human decision bound to the exact pending question. questionId must equal replyToQuestionId. It cannot grant unrelated effects or lift diagnosis-only mode.

CancelOperation.description: Idempotent exact-target stop. At least one current goal/run is required. Does not undo prior effects; stale or superseded control is rejected.

TaskQuestionCard.description: A durable same-task question. Any freeform answer is submitted as a normal signed prompt; choices do not restrict the response.

activity.description: Current admitted delivery activity for this owned conversation.

TaskWorkspace.description: Read-only task card from native state and bound checkpoint artifacts. Shared readers receive a bounded projection, not another person's raw transcript.

DisplaySnapshot.description: Display-device-only household projection. No conversations, mailbox, private wiki, receipts, diagnostic reports, credentials or arbitrary artifacts are exposed.

folderId.description: Client-generated stable UUID, reused for an uncertain create retry.
Owned folder ID; null returns this viewer's conversation to Unfiled.
